notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata fetching collects title, description, and favicon but not a preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but bookmark notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Saving an existing URL creates another bookmark without duplicate detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no existing-tag autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, domain, description, and tags, but not notes or the complete URL.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesized search groups are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are not handled as exact-match expressions.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot be applied to all bookmarks matching the current filter.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and Markdown rendering are not implemented.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not implemented.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Bookmarks cannot be archived.
REF-BM-27: No reversible archive operation exists to distinguish from permanent deletion.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Collections are static bookmark fields, not reusable dynamic search/tag bundles.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: No persistent personal display-settings facility exists for defaults, item count, or font size.
